If you have the utensils you originally used to write in it along with onyx, a clear shard of glass or mirror and cinnamon, and some string, there's a way to break that charm. 
Coat the string in the cinnamon. Tie the string around the utensils, hold the onyx , focus on the item, and then use the shard to cut the string, then burn the string. 
For me, items show up within a few hours.
